technique_name: Explain how artificial intelligence improves customer service.
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly improved customer service by automating mundane tasks, performing accurate data analysis, and providing more personalized customer service. AI chatbots can respond to simple queries, such as FAQs, redirecting customers to the right areas, and helping with data entry.
